projects.title: DISC
projects.description:
After graduating from the University of Utah, a few of us that worked on our senior project (and now published video game Origami Kami) decided to stay together and continue to make games. Our current project is DISC! 


DISC combines Ultimate Frisbee with Super Smash Brothers in this top-down, non-violent action, multiplayer game focused on teamwork and synergy. Coordinate with your friends and pull off sick plays to win big! 
 
Platform - PC, Mac, Linux, consoles (Xbox, PlayStation, Wii, Steam Box)
Art Style - Futuristic, stylized caricatures
Audience - Intermediate gamers who enjoy social competition. Rating is for all ages. 

Gameplay Basics -
•	Goal is to catch the disc inside of the enemy’s “end zone”
•	When the player has the disc, they cannot move
•	While holding the disc, the player may then throw it in any direction
•	The player’s teammates will pass the disc back and forth until they reach the goal
•	Avoid being intercepted by the other team 

Story - In 2140, Esports and regular sports have come together. The latest and most popular game is DISC: A game of Ultimate Frisbee within special digital arenas that have been constructed to provide a video game-like experience with the physical sport. An electrified disc is used that roots players to the floor while it is in their possession so that they must consistently pass the disc between players to make it to the end zone. 

What makes us different - This game is the perfect mix of a sports game with friendly cooperation and fierce competition, combined with sci-fi and fantasy elements of a futuristic environment. The teams will compete in a variety of arenas that consistently change and bring challenging obstacles to the game. Teamwork is required in that players must strategize and work together to achieve victory. We plan to touch back to the roots of gaming where you gather with your friends at the arcade and play together.
